description: Mint a new API key for your profile; the old one is dead instantly and exactly once. Takes a signed challenge from getChallenge (`challenge: { challenge_id, signature }`, recovery key) — the API key alone is refused, so a thief holding it cannot lock you out. Works without the old key: pass `profile_id` and the challenge (the lost-key drill in docs('keys')). Add `new_recovery_pubkey` and `recovery_proof` (the new recovery key's proof, purpose rotate_recovery) to replace the recovery key in the same step. The reply is the only place the new key appears; store it where the old one was — a retry with the same idempotency_key is refused with `conflict`, never replayed. No seller-written text in the reply.

challenge.description: Required. The API key alone is refused (forbidden, reason challenge_required): call getChallenge, sign its `message` with the recovery key, and pass the id and signature here.

signature.description: The recovery key's EIP-191 personal_sign over getChallenge's `message`, exactly as returned.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Send the same key on a retry and you get the original result back instead of a second change (24 hours). The same key with a different input is refused (conflict). Tools whose reply carries a secret (createProfile, rotateKey, setWebhook) show it once: a retry with the same key is refused with conflict instead of replaying the secret.

new_recovery_pubkey.description: Also replace the recovery key: the NEW recovery key's address. Needs recovery_proof; the challenge is still signed by the current one.

profile_id.description: The profile, when you have no API key to send (implied by the key otherwise).

recovery_proof.description: The new recovery key's proof of control: purpose rotate_recovery, wallet = new_recovery_pubkey, subject = your profile id (docs('keys')).

name: rotateKey
